message:
You know, I’ve always admired those folks who seem to have it all figured out during storms — they’ve got their flashlights ready, snacks stashed, and a plan in place. Well, after a few too many last-minute dashes to the store, I decided it was time to become one of those prepared people. 

I found this handy resource that covers everything from staying cool during a heatwave to making sure you’ve got what you need on hand. It’s like having a cheat sheet for those unpredictable weather days. 

Now, I feel like I can finally hold my head high when the skies get dark! What’s your favorite tip for staying prepared when the weather takes a turn? ☀️
